in_marathi.name: Puran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Puran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Puran is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘purana’ which means ancient, old, and wise. It is a name that signifies a deep understanding of the world and the wisdom that comes with age.
